objective: Create scripts/runner/actions-budget.mjs so a long coder run is refused when it would spend the month's GitHub Actions allowance. Export DEFAULT_ESTIMATED_RUN_MINUTES (120), DEFAULT_RESERVE_MINUTES (300) and evaluateActionsBudget({ includedMinutes, usedMinutes, estimatedRunMinutes, reserveMinutes }) returning { decision, remaining, reason }: "unknown" when either count is missing or not finite; "allow" with a reason mentioning 'No metered Actions allowance' when includedMinutes is 0; otherwise remaining = max(0, included - used) and "block" when remaining - run < reserve (exact equality allows), with a reason stating '<used> of <included> minutes used', '<remaining> remaining', 'about <run>' and the '<reserve>-minute reserve'. Running the file as a script reads ATLAS_ESTIMATED_RUN_MINUTES, ATLAS_ACTIONS_MINUTES_RESERVE, GH_TOKEN and ATLAS_BILLING_ACCOUNT. scripts/runner/actions-budget.test.mjs must pass.
